exam_scheme.note: Kerala Engineering Architecture Medical (KEAM) is conducted by the Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Government of Kerala. The Engineering Entrance Examination is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) across multiple sessions with 150 objective multiple-choice questions (Mathematics: 75 questions, Physics: 45 questions, Chemistry: 30 questions) for a total duration of 180 minutes. For each correct response 4 marks are awarded, and 1 mark is deducted for each incorrect response. Raw scores out of 600 are normalized to an index mark out of 300. The final Engineering rank list is compiled with 50:50 equal weightage between normalized KEAM scores (300 marks) and standardized Class 12 / Plus Two Board examination marks in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry (300 marks).
